story.title: A St. Louis race morning for remembrance, support, and safe-sleep education.
paragraphs: Strides gathers families, runners, walkers, volunteers, and donors at Tower Grove Park during Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month.
Participation supports Infant Loss Resources programs for grief support, awareness, safe sleep education, and family resources across Missouri and neighboring communities.

items.label: VENUE
items.title: Tower Grove Park, Sons of Rest Pavilion
items.description: The in-person race and walk are listed at the Sons of Rest Pavilion, 4257 Northeast Dr. in St. Louis.

items.label: FAMILY DAY
items.title: Activities for runners, walkers, kids, and supporters
items.description: Race day includes food, beverages, medals, a kids zone, music, fitness activities, special visitors, and a family-friendly strollers-and-dogs policy.

items.label: MISSION
items.title: Support, awareness, and safe-sleep education
items.description: The event helps fund Infant Loss Resources programs supporting grieving families and safe infant sleep education.

faqs.question: Where is the in-person race held?
faqs.answer: The in-person event is at Tower Grove Park's Sons of Rest Pavilion, 4257 Northeast Dr., St. Louis, MO 63110.

faqs.question: What time do the in-person options start?
faqs.answer: The in-person 5K and 1-mile fun run/walk start at 8:30 AM CDT.

faqs.question: Are strollers and dogs allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes. The event is family friendly, and strollers and dogs are allowed.

faqs.question: What does the race support?
faqs.answer: The event supports Infant Loss Resources programs for grief support, awareness, safe sleep education, and family resources.
